messages:
mina: FYI onboarding nova-v1 int8 — small repro: CJK corner quotes flip when a Chinese phrase follows an Arabic fragment. float32 decode is fine.

lee: paste tokenizer + minimal case? staging only or local too?

mina: tokenizer=nova-sp. Repro: Translate to zh: "He said \"Good morning\" in Arabic: صباح الخير". int8 decode shows corner quotes swapped around the CJK phrase.

yusuf: token ids roundtrip identical between float32 and int8, so likely detok table or fused-detok kernel reorder when has_rtl is true. bisecting detok_fuse and detok_table changes.

sasha: mitigation: force detok_table_v1 for has_rtl inputs on int8 as a canary hotfix. add a unit/regression test to token-diff-suite covering mixed-orientation quotes and a token->char roundtrip for float32 vs int8.

infra-bot: canary deploy started: nova-int8-hotfix -> ppool-5 at 2800001200

mina: validating canary now. will rerun minimal repro and a 150-sample mixed-locale smoke and report chrF/BLEU.

yusuf: bisect quick update: change introducing conditional reorder in detok_fuse_v2 commit a4b7d3 introduces the behavior locally. preparing revert PR + tests.

sasha: created ENG-ML-1501 to track: "nova-int8 detok flip for CJK after RTL". linking PRs and smoke artifacts once available. Keep updates here.
